- 💀 **Persistent Malware**: Malicious code injected at compile time is extremely hard to detect
- ⚠️ **System Instability**: Replacing a core system binary can break the entire build toolchain

## This Violates

- Basic security principles
- System integrity
- Potentially laws regarding unauthorized system modification and malware distribution
